Level 3:

Username: natas3
Password: 3gqisGdR0pjm6tpkDKdIWO2hSvchLeYH
URL:      http://natas3.natas.labs.overthewire.org

This level will require knowledge of robots.txt which is a file on a website that gives instructions to bots that crawl websites on the pages they can and cannot access.

Now in the level instead of the flag being in the comment we get this hint:

<!-- No more information leaks!! Not even Google will find it this time... -->

Knowing robots.txt you would recognize that is what the hint is refering to and when we go to http://natas3.natas.labs.overthewire.org/robots.txt we see:

User-agent: *
Disallow: /s3cr3t/

This shows us there is a directory /s3cr3t/ which when we go to we find users.txt where the flag is stored:

natas4:QryZXc2e0zahULdHrtHxzyYkj59kUxLQ

Level 4:

Username: natas4
Password: QryZXc2e0zahULdHrtHxzyYkj59kUxLQ
URL:      http://natas4.natas.labs.overthewire.org

This level we see the hint:

Access disallowed. You are visiting from “http://natas4.natas.labs.overthewire.org/” while authorized users should come only from “http://natas5.natas.labs.overthewire.org/”

This means we need to change where we are visting this site from but since we can’t enter natas5 we need to change our http request to say we are eventhough we aren’t. We can do this through using Burp Suite where we can edit the http header ‘Referer’ to “http://natas5.natas.labs.overthewire.org/”. Now that it thinks we are visting from natas5 we get the following response:

Access granted. The password for natas5 is 0n35PkggAPm2zbEpOU802c0x0Msn1ToK

Level 5:

Username: natas5
Password: 0n35PkggAPm2zbEpOU802c0x0Msn1ToK
URL:      http://natas5.natas.labs.overthewire.org

This time we are told “Access disallowed. You are not logged in” then when we look again at the http request we can see there is a cookie called loggedin which is set to 0. So again in Burp Suite we edit the http request and change the cookie from 0 to 1. And this time we get the response:

Access granted. The password for natas6 is 0RoJwHdSKWFTYR5WuiAewauSuNaBXned

Username: natas6

In this level we are asked to input a secret to get the flag. We are also shown the source code and we can see from the line:

include "includes/secret.inc";

That the password is stored at that domain so when we visit http://natas6.natas.labs.overthewire.org/includes/secret.inc we find the secret in the comments of the html.

<!--?$secret = "FOEIUWGHFEEUHOFUOIU";?-->

When we input this secret we get:

Access granted. The password for natas7 is bmg8SvU1LizuWjx3y7xkNERkHxGre0GS

Level 7:

Username: natas7
Password: bmg8SvU1LizuWjx3y7xkNERkHxGre0GS
URL:      http://natas7.natas.labs.overthewire.org

In this level there are two pages and in both the pages we see the following hint in the html:

<!-- hint: password for webuser natas8 is in /etc/natas_webpass/natas8 -->

We also see that the url for the home and about page contains a query “?page=home” so if we change this to “/etc/natas_webpass/natas8” we can instead fetch the file with the flag. So using this url:
http://natas7.natas.labs.overthewire.org/index.php?page=/etc/natas_webpass/natas8
Where we get the flag:
xcoXLmzMkoIP9D7hlgPlh9XD7OgLAe5Q

Level 8:

Username: natas8
Password: xcoXLmzMkoIP9D7hlgPlh9XD7OgLAe5Q
URL:      http://natas8.natas.labs.overthewire.org

Again we have to input a secret and we are also given the source code. But this time we are shown the encoded secret. By looking at the function to encode we can see they encode it in base 64 then reverse it and then finally change it from binary to hex. So to decode the secret we will do the reverse to the encoded secret: “3d3d516343746d4d6d6c315669563362”
First we change it from hex to binary with this line of php:

echo hex2bin("3d3d516343746d4d6d6c315669563362");

And we get: “==QcCtmMml1ViV3b”
Now we reverse this:

echo strrev("==QcCtmMml1ViV3b");

Getting: “b3ViV1lmMmtCcQ”
Now we base 64 decode this:

echo base64_decode("b3ViV1lmMmtCcQ==");

Finally we have the secret “oubWYf2kBq” which when we submit we get:
Access granted. The password for natas9 is ZE1ck82lmdGIoErlhQgWND6j2Wzz6b6t

Level 9:

Username: natas9
Password: ZE1ck82lmdGIoErlhQgWND6j2Wzz6b6t
URL:      http://natas9.natas.labs.overthewire.org

This level we have an input where we get an output of words containing our input. We can see how the code handles our input from this line:

passthru("grep -i $key dictionary.txt");

Seeing this we can do an injection to instead give us the flag. So instead we can give the following input:

'' /etc/natas_webpass/natas10 #

This input gives us everything in the file and comments out the dictionary.txt from the command which gives us the flag:
t7I5VHvpa14sJTUGV0cbEsbYfFP2dmOu
